system.description:
“You cannot fight the ocean. You can only drown in it.” As an Oathsworn of the Sea, you are a relentless force of nature, summoning crashing waves to knock your enemies down and empowering your strikes with the crushing pressure of the abyss.

LEVEL 3

Oath of the Sea.

You no longer know Radiant spells, you instead know Water spells. Your Radiant Judgement becomes Depth’s Judgment and can deal Bludgeoning or Cold damage. You gain a swim speed equal to your walking speed and can hold your breath twice as long.

Tidal Aura.

You gain a Burst 4 aura. Allies in the area gain the benefits of your Oath of Sea. When you start your turn in a Large body of water you gain 1 Judgment Die.

Large Body of Water?: Mostly up the GM’s discretion, but objects/things/structures also “generally” follow monster/creature sizes. So a Large body of water would take up about 4+ spaces on a grid.

LEVEL 7

Rushing Wave.

(1/encounter) 1 Action, Burst: 8. Enemies in the area must make a STR save. On a fail, they are knocked Prone. The area fills with magical sea water for 1 minute.

LEVEL 11

Crushing Depths.

When you use Depth’s Judgment, your target is knocked Prone and Slowed. They can’t stand until they remove Slowed by spending an action on their turn.

Blessing of the Depths.

You take WIL less Bludgeoning and Cold damage and can now breathe underwater. You ignore any negative consequence of deep dives.

LEVEL 15

Churning Seas.

(1/Safe Rest) When you use Rushing Wave, you can choose to maintain Concentration on it for up to 1 minute. During this time, you can use 1 Action to repeat its effect.

Sacred Decrees

Crushing Aura. (1/Safe Rest) 1 Action. Enemies in your aura must make a STR save. On a fail, they are knocked Prone and take LVL Bludgeoning or Cold damage. Half damage on a save and they are Slowed, 1 round.

Tidal Rush. (1/turn) Free Action. When standing in a Large body of water, you gain +4 speed.

Raging Tide. Reaction: When an enemy in your aura hits you or an ally. The attacker takes Bludgeoning or Cold damage equal to 1 roll of your Judgment Die. They must then make a STR save. On a fail, they are pushed STR spaces away. If they are adjacent to you, they automatically fail. You can use this WIL/Safe Rest.
